a.h2: Peace of mind and reliability in every engine.
a.p: One turn of the key. Four cylinders breathe in a 1-3-4-2 sequence, the exhaust lets out its first breath and the whole system comes alive.

b.p: Full load. Two pistons up, two down: a perfectly balanced crankshaft to keep the pump going where other engines give up.

c.p: Live technical exploded view: every part labelled. Tap any part to see its spare parts.

d.p: End of cycle: parts return to place, the block cools down and is ready for the next shift. That's how every workday ends — and how yours begins.

benefits.intro: Every JF unit leaves the workshop tested under real load. This is what you get from the very first start.

rows.p: Mining-grade cast blocks, bench-verified torque and tolerances checked part by part before shipping.
Flat torque curve from 1,200 rpm: the pump holds steady flow even with dense slurry and suspended solids.
Parts for your engine and pump set with compatibility information. Get quotes and arrange everything on WhatsApp.
Calibrated to operate above 2,500 m: compensated injection, cold start and oversized cooling.

guides.title: Guides
guides.intro: Practical guides to choose, care for and repair your equipment. They are general guidance: always follow your equipment manufacturer's manual.

items.h: How to choose a pump set
steps: Flow: how much water or slurry you need to move, in litres per minute. Work it out from the volume to drain and the time available.
Total head: add the suction height (from the water to the pump), the discharge height (from the pump to the outlet) and the hose losses, which grow with length and bends.
What you will pump: for slurry or sandy water choose a solids-handling pump with an abrasion-resistant impeller.
Suction and discharge diameter: it must match your hoses; a narrower hose reduces flow.
Altitude: diesel engines lose power at higher altitude. For high-mountain work ask about a turbocharged engine.
With that data (flow, head and type of fluid) message us and we will recommend the right unit.
Before starting: check oil and coolant levels and look for leaks.
Air filter: mining sites are dusty; check and clean it often. A clogged filter cuts power and wears the engine.
Clean fuel: drain water from the fuel separator filter and store diesel in clean, closed containers.
Radiator: keep the fins clean and check the hoses and the fan belt.
Oil and filter changes: follow the hour-meter intervals in the manual, not just the calendar.
If you notice abnormal smoke, loss of power, knocking or overheating, stop the unit and contact us.

items.h: How to order the right spare part
steps: Take a photo of the engine or unit plate: it shows the model and serial number.
Photograph the damaged part from several angles, with a ruler or tape next to it to show the size.
If you can, note key measurements: diameter, number of teeth, thread type or length.
Search the spare parts catalogue filtered by your engine, or send everything on WhatsApp and we will confirm the part.

app.title: JF Monitor
app.subtitle: Your pump sets in your pocket, in real time.
app.intro: We are building an app to see from your phone how your JF units are working, with the same account you use on this site.
app.scroll: Scroll to see how it will work

phases.p: Flow, pressure and temperature of every unit, from the mine entrance or from the city.
The app watches trends: if pressure drops or temperature rises, you see it before it becomes a problem.
A notification tells you the unit, the value and what to check first.
The alert reaches the WhatsApp of the people in charge, even if the app isn't open.
Lower the speed or stop the pump set from your phone, without walking to the face.
Confirm in seconds that everything is back in range, and it's logged in the history.

screen.waMsg: ⚠ JF-M40 #0042 · Temperature 104 °C. Check radiator and coolant.

features.p: Readings from sensors installed on the pump set, sent over cellular, LoRa or satellite depending on the site.
Phone notifications when a value leaves its range: temperature, pressure, flow or a stopped unit.
Start, stop, speed up or slow down the engine from your phone, with confirmation and a log of who did it.
Charts by day and shift to understand performance and plan maintenance.
Reminders based on the real hour meter: oil change, filters and inspections.
Several sites and pump sets on one screen, only for you and JF Motores.
Sign in with the same email or Google; the units you bought appear automatically.

app.disclaimer: The app is in development. Features and launch date may change; the images are a simulation.
app.cta: Let me know when it's ready
app.wa: Hello JF Motores, I'd like to know when the JF Monitor app is ready.
app.plansIntro: Three levels depending on what you need to see. Prices will be set at launch: they depend on the connection available at your site (cellular or satellite).
app.includesPrev: Everything in the previous plan, plus:

plans.name: Essential
items: Running hours, temperature, pressure and flow
Phone alerts when something goes out of range
Unit location and history by shift
plans.needs: Cellular connection; satellite optional for areas without signal.

plans.name: Vision
items: Live video at 30 frames per second when you open the app
Continuous on-device recording to review later
Video clip attached to every alert
plans.needs: Requires good 4G signal or a satellite antenna on site.

plans.name: Vision Pro
items: Live video and cloud recording around the clock
Several cameras, including a thermal one to detect overheating
Alert if people or vehicles approach the unit at night
Remote control included: start, stop and adjust speed
Assistance from a JF technician watching the same video
plans.needs: Requires unlimited satellite connection and permanent power (solar or grid).

app.plansNote: Cameras are designed for surface units (open pit, mine entrance, dredges); inside underground workings each case is assessed. They are installed with a video-surveillance notice, as personal data law requires.
app.extrasIntro: It will work like professional pumping equipment: a required base plan plus add-ons you choose for your operation.

extras.p: Start, stop, speed up and slow down the engine from the app, with confirmation and a log of every command.
If nobody sees the notification, the system calls the people in charge, one after another.
For sites without mobile signal: data and alerts arrive via satellite.
Detailed history with more readings per minute and downloadable reports by shift or month.

app.extrasNote: The Essential plan is the base: add-ons and camera plans are added on top of it.
